SGB Browser v2.0.44 Official Complete Public Release:
• Added 2 new 100% non-repeating mobile browser modes in Bot #7 (9-Mode Anti-Detect Engine): 'iPhone Old Safari' (classic iPhone iOS 12–15 Mobile Safari) and 'Brave Mobile Browser' (strictly Android & iPhone ONLY with authentic navigator.brave + Sec-GPC: 1 headers) using cryptographic zero-repeat User-Agent generation.
• Added Permanent Zero-Trace Ephemeral Cleanup inside Bot #7 (instant CDP cookie/cache wipe + ephemeral session directory shredding + garbage collection after every browser close while keeping saved profiles 100% intact).
• Upgraded Bot #7 '🔍 Filter' (Headless GraphQL Number Filter Engine) to 50 Worker Threads (1–50) with Pre-Warmed 5-Slot Multi-Session Token Pool, strict No-Account verification, and smooth table scroll throttling.
• Fixed crisp, always-visible Up/Down (▲/▼) arrow buttons on all Threads, Delay & Filter Worker Threads spinboxes and clean non-overlapping Row 2 layout.
• Eliminated VPN Search Bar 'Not Responding' freezes on 4GB/8GB RAM PCs via 300ms debounce, background bridge sync, and background startup cleanup.
• Includes all v2.0.43 stability fixes (Get Token Cookie extension 1-click import/login, full c_user+xs capture, 5-format export, and StudioFramelessModal fixes).
